'''Zalizar Zudii''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Zudii detailed an encounter with the [[Bharhulai]] tribe of [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] when they attacked the smuggler's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and damaged the exterior.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
